# Fortnightly tax table Withholding tax table for payments made on a fortnightly basis. **Published** 17 June 2026 ## On this page - [Using this tax table](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Usingthistaxtable) - [Working out the withholding amount](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Workingoutthewithholdingamount) - [Tax file number (TFN) declarations](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-TaxfilenumberTFNdeclarations) - [When your payee has a study and training support loan debt](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Whenyourpayeehasastudyandtrainingsupportloandebt) - [Allowances](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Allowances) - [Leave payments and termination payments made to employees](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Leavepaymentsandterminationpaymentsmadetoemployees) - [Leave loading](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Leaveloading) - [Withholding declarations](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Withholdingdeclarations) - [Medicare levy adjustment](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Medicarelevyadjustment) - [When your payee is a foreign resident](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-table-fortnightly#ato-Whenyourpayeeisaforeignresident) ## Using this tax table **This tax table applies to payments made from 1 July 2026.** Use this tax table if you make any of the following payments to an individual on a fortnightly basis: ## Working out the withholding amount ### When there are 27 pays in a financial year | Fortnightly earnings
